sequences.story: The players execute various high-stakes robberies, including a bar and a bank, accumulate money, engage in rooftop escapes, steal vehicles from an airport, and try out quirky activities like meditation and exploring cruise ships before pulling off daring stunts.
Jason steals a truck, drives through various environments, listens to the radio, and arrives at a swamp dock to investigate a missing package.

Lucia helps her mother clean up their dilapidated property, survives an alligator attack in the pool, deals with an armed gang confrontation, and ultimately uses an excavator to demolish the gang's house in retaliation.
Lucia carjacks an Ocelot Jugular, drives to Watkins Auto Parts, and negotiates with Moses to prove her car boosting skills.
